suggestions.after:
# Hello World!

## Project Setup Guide

This guide walks you through setting up a Git repository from scratch.

## Prerequisites

- Git installed on your system
- Unix-like shell (Bash, Zsh, etc.)
- Write permissions to your home directory

## Installation
suggestions.benefits: Creates proper document hierarchy, sets context for users, provides clear structure for navigation

suggestions.description: Create a structured section for each command with consistent formatting
suggestions.before:
Initialized empty Git repository in /Users/your_user_directory/Hello-World/.git/
$ touch README
suggestions.after:
## Step-by-Step Instructions

### Step 1: Create Project Directory
```bash
$ mkdir ~/Hello-World
```
This creates a new directory in your home folder.

### Step 2: Navigate to Directory
```bash
$ cd ~/Hello-World
```

### Step 3: Initialize Git Repository
```bash
$ git init
```
Expected output:
```
Initialized empty Git repository in /path/to/Hello-World/.git/
```

### Step 4: Create README File
```bash
$ touch README
```
This creates an empty README file for your project.
